item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Shepherd's pie with a flavourful filling of brown lentils, mushrooms, carrots and peas in a rich herb gravy, topped with a golden, crisp-baked layer of creamy mashed potato. (6+10)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Crisp falafel served with silky hummus, quinoa and a fresh fattoush salad, topped with herbs. Served with crisp flatbread, sumac and pomegranate vinaigrette plus a garlic dressing on the side. (1+2+8+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Potato frittata with grilled peppers and aioli. (2+6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Masoor dal with jeera rice, topped with namkeen. Served with coriander, lime, chilli sauce and raita. (1+6)
